# flow_kubernetes_load_balancer (Data Source)

a load balancer that a service of type `LoadBalancer` inside the cluster created



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) unique identifier of the cluster

### Optional

- `id` (Number) unique identifier of the load balancer
- `name` (String) name of the load balancer

### Read-Only

- `location_id` (Number) unique identifier of the location
- `network_id` (Number) unique identifier of the network the load balancer is attached to
- `private_ip` (String) private IP address of the load balancer
- `public_ip` (String) public IP address of the load balancer, unset if it has none
- `status` (String) current status of the load balancer, as a stable key
